headline: US Grocers Take Losses on Thanksgiving Bundles to Attract Shoppers
summary: US grocery chains are taking losses on Thanksgiving meal promotions to draw foot traffic. While large retailers like Walmart leverage scale to turn profits, smaller regional grocers report margin pressure.
why: Retail grocery bundling strategies during major holidays impact profit margins and reflect consumer spending trends in the US retail sector.

impacts.name: Walmart Inc.
impacts.why: Walmart's scale allows it to maintain profitability on discounted holiday bundles relative to smaller competitors.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
